Fugazi song performance intensity data

Source: R/data.R
fugazi_song_performance_intensity.Rd

Fugazi song performance intensity data

Usage

fugazi_song_performance_intensity

Format

dataframe with one row for each song in the Fugazi discography, except those which never appear in the Fugazi Live Series data.

songid

numeric id for each song

title

The name of the song

launchdate

The date on which the song was first performed according to the data

chosen

The number of times the song was performed according to the data

available_rl

The number of shows for which the song was available in the band's repertoire

intensity

The performance intensity is the ratio of chosen/available_rl

Source

https://www.dischord.com/fugazi_live_series

Provenance

Derived-modeled. Produced by Repeatr_2 from the min_song_count-eligible subset only (it needs available_rl, which is only tracked for songs that got an alt) - unlike fugazi_song_counts, one-off/rare songs are not included here.

Examples

fugazi_song_performance_intensity
#> # A tibble: 92 × 6
#>    songid title                launchdate chosen available_rl intensity
#>     <int> <chr>                <date>      <dbl>        <dbl>     <dbl>
#>  1     17 cashout              2000-06-04     67           74     0.905
#>  2     20 closed captioned     1997-06-18    169          211     0.801
#>  3      7 bed for the scraping 1994-11-20    310          393     0.789
#>  4     59 number 5             1998-11-21    120          157     0.764
#>  5     68 reclamation          1990-05-05    612          820     0.746
#>  6      4 arpeggiator          1997-05-02    163          220     0.741
#>  7     10 break                1996-08-15    179          244     0.734
#>  8     23 do you like me       1994-11-20    282          393     0.718
#>  9     91 waiting room         1987-09-03    675          952     0.709
#> 10      9 blueprint            1989-09-23    608          873     0.696
#> # ℹ 82 more rows
